Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Alma Esposito | DOB: 08/11/1958 | MRN: SYN-9409907
Date of service: 10/24/2025 | Dr. Ravi Penrose, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
67-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2023, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypothyroidism, gastroesophageal reflux.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 25 mg weekly for 29 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 5.3 (high disease activity).
Plan: start fictimab 160 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
